description: When a handler modifies the session, a cookie is emitted carrying the full updated contents plus the creation timestamp, marked http-only and scoped to the root path.

cases.expected_output:
status=200
loaded.new=false
loaded.empty=false
loaded.contents={"a": 1, "b": 2}
set_cookie=present
cookie.cleared=false
cookie.httponly=true
cookie.path=/
cookie.domain=127.0.0.1
payload.created=1000000000
payload.session={"a": 1, "b": 2, "c": 3}
